notes: THE SHIPPED DEFAULT, and the LOW ANCHOR of the reward scale. It is what a training script does when nobody chose an evaluation policy: run to the end, evaluate once with everything you were willing to spend, keep that checkpoint. On a run whose data pipeline degrades before the end it keeps the worst checkpoint it could have kept. The verifier replays it from scratch on every grading run rather than reading a stored number for it, so the floor of the scale is measured on the same drawn run your policy is measured on.
